title: hive stack output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive stack TARGET (--on PREREQUISITE... | --clear) --json`. Sets or clears an existing unfinished task's meta.yml depends_on declaration under the task lease and records one hive/state commit. The success payload reports the admission verdict the task now has; a missing or blocked prerequisite is a successful write with dependency.state wait or admission_error, while a cycle, a finished task, a draft-PR workflow, or a conflicting plan.md frontmatter declaration is an error.

Declaration.description: A depends_on declaration: null (none), one task reference, or a nonempty flat list of references (scheduling-only).

reason_code.description: A Hive::DependencyAdmission::REASON_CODES value; deliberately unenumerated here so new admission reasons do not fan out to this schema.

project.description: Registry name of the task's project.

id.description: Numeric task id from meta.yml, or null for a legacy task without one.

stage.description: Stage directory the task is in, e.g. 3-plan. Never the workflow's terminal stage.

previous_depends_on.description: The declaration meta.yml held before this command.

changed.description: False when the requested declaration already matched meta.yml; nothing was written.

committed.description: True when the change was recorded as a hive/state commit.

state.description: Admission verdict for the task with its new declaration, as status and the daemon will report it.

notes.description: Human-readable consequences: list or cross-project scheduling-only policy, an existing worktree that is not rebased, or the admission hold to resolve.

error_class.description: Short name (no module prefix) of the Hive::Error subclass that was raised.

error_kind.description: usage = malformed invocation, or neither/both of --on and --clear (64). invalid_task_path / ambiguous_slug = TARGET did not resolve to one task (64). wrong_stage = TARGET is in its workflow's terminal stage (4). invalid_dependency = a reference failed the depends_on grammar (64). dependency_cycle = the edge would close a cycle or point at TARGET itself (64). unsupported_workflow = draft-PR workflows do not support dependency stacking (64). plan_conflict = TARGET's plan.md frontmatter declares a different dependency (78). concurrent_run = a stage agent or another writer holds TARGET's lease or the commit lock (75). stale_task = TARGET moved during the update (75). config = invalid meta.yml or project enrollment (78). git = the hive/state commit failed and meta.yml was restored (70). internal = uncategorised crash (70). error = any other Hive::Error (1).

reason_code.description: Present on plan_conflict: plan_dependency_mismatch or plan_dependency_missing.

offending_ref.description: Present on plan_conflict: the declaration plan.md holds.

safe_correction.description: Present on plan_conflict: the exact edit that makes plan.md agree.

holder.description: Present on concurrent_run when the existing lease holder's metadata is recoverable. Properties are best-effort.

lock_path.description: Present on concurrent_run and stale_task: the lease or lock that refused the write.
